title: Halve the stock
prompt: For every product in category 4, return name and half: its stock divided by 2, keeping the fraction. A stock of 45 gives 22.5.
hints: stock is an integer. What does an integer divided by an integer give?
One side of the division must not be an integer.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Divides two integers, so the fraction is dropped.
Converts after the integer division has already dropped the fraction.

feedback: Find the product with a stock of 45. Its half should be 22.5, not 22.
